alternation.note: the two orbits alternate along the record, so the orbit contrast is a trailing-window difference and not a paired test
alternation.rule: one orbit per 6-day acquisition day, so no acquisition day carries both a usable ascending and a usable descending echo and a per-day orbit difference does not exist

axis.definition: the acquisition day, one dot per echo-bearing chip; the two orbits of a day are separated by a sub-day offset of 0.18 d
axis.name: acquisition_day
axis.note: the event falls inside a drawn 12-day step, so the two stretches meet at a band and not at a point

covariates.note: what else moves with the pass geometry: the per-orbit medians of the export's co-variates. Ascending passes are the 09:2x UT ones, descending the 21:2x UT ones, so temperature and intensity move with the orbit by construction — they would have to be held fixed before an orbit split of the mask channels meant anything physical

bootstrap.note: the paper result's own n_boot and rng_seed, re-derived here so every CI of this figure is reproducible
bootstrap.statistic: median(DESC) - median(ASC), each orbit resampled independently

difference.confound: the record's only post-event echo chip is an ascending pass, so the pooled difference and the before-the-collapse difference are two different contrasts: the pre-only column drops that chip and shows how much of the pooled number is state rather than orbit
difference.definition: delta_orbit = median(DESC) - median(ASC) over the echo-bearing chips
difference.note: median(DESC) - median(ASC) over the echo-bearing chips: a descriptive pass-geometry difference, never a damage or orbit verdict. The two orbits are disjoint sets of acquisition days, so the chips are not paired and no causal reading is available

difference.sign: positive means the descending passes read higher on that channel; Cliff's delta is called with the ascending chips as reference, which gives the identical sign

chain.note: the export's own orbit_direction and pass_label agree with the measurement extract and with the resolved bursts on every chip; the cross-layer pins carry the three disagreement counts, all 0

orbits.geometry_sentence: the record's passes are ASC is IW3 on relative orbit 54 (09:2x UT, VV x 11 + VH x 9); DESC is IW2 on relative orbit 61 (21:2x UT, VH x 10 + VV x 3)
orbits.note: both orbits straddle the collapse date and the only post-event echo chip is an ascending pass: this block describes where the echoes sit over the two pass geometries, it is not an orbit contrast of the states

panels.floor_ticks: the 16 echo-free chips: no ordinate on any channel, drawn on the panel floor
panels.g: the pooled difference beside the pre-only one, each with its seeded 95% CI, a star for a CI that excludes zero
panels.h: the 33 chips per orbit and state, split into their echo-bearing and echo-free parts, with both Fisher tests printed

provenance.note: the nine committed inputs, by content; the same digests the analysis reference names, re-read here and pinned

role: companion: delta_orbit = median(DESC) - median(ASC) per channel, pooled and as a trailing-window series, with the pass geometry, the coverage of the two orbits and the co-variate controls; it adds no number to the A-E pin contract of fig_ywf_ocv_paper.py

series.join_rule: a line is drawn only between two consecutive points one cadence step (6 d) apart; every longer step of the series is left open
series.no_interpolation: a day whose window holds fewer than 2 chips of either orbit keeps no point, and no value is interpolated across a hole
series.note: every kept day is pre-event: the record's single post-event echo chip has no descending chip in its own window

title: YWF — the orbit split of the echo-mask vector: the two pass geometries alternate, so the split is a trailing-window difference
